clue.text: Neighbourly get-together

definitions.meaning: neighbourly means friendly and sociable towards those nearby
a get-together is an informal party or gathering

explanation.definitionFit: The word works as an adjective meaning friendly and companionable and as a noun for an informal party.

clue.text: Care nothing for ridicule

definitions.meaning: to care nothing for something is to disdain it

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to disdain or despise; as a noun it means open contempt or derision.

clue.text: Married in a fit of lunacy? That's slander

indicators.note: in places the single letter for the marriage inside the shuffled madness
a fit suggests the letters of lunacy are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: Someone marrying in a moment of madness, and a gossip calling that slanderous.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a fit of' rearranges LUNACY to CALUNY, and 'in' puts M inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words mean a false and damaging statement about someone.

clue.text: Sailor ordered to look up those missing

parts.note: AB, able-bodied seaman, is a common crossword sailor
ordered, as in ordered away or dispatched, means sent

indicators.note: in a down clue, up tells the solver to read the word for look from bottom to top

parts.note: to look is to see

explanation.surface: A sailor told to search for the crew who have gone absent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ordered' looks like an anagram signal but means SENT; 'up' turns SEE into EES.
explanation.definitionFit: Absentees are people who are not present, the ones missing.

clue.text: One can't run out of it

definitions.text: One can't run out of it

parts.words: One can't run out of it
parts.note: reads like something inexhaustible, but plays on the idiom of being out of puff after a run: you cannot keep running once this is exhausted

explanation.definitionFit: Runners proverbially run out of air in the lungs, so this is the thing whose lack stops a run.

clue.text: Gave a straight decision?

parts.note: a judge giving a decision issues a ruling, and lines on paper made straight are drawn with a rule

explanation.definitionFit: Ruled means decided judicially, and ruled paper bears straight lines, so both senses meet.

clue.text: Where joan of Arc was bound to be in jeopardy

definitions.text: Where joan of Arc was bound
definitions.meaning: Joan of Arc was tied to a post and burnt in 1431

explanation.definitionFit: Literally tied to the post for burning, and idiomatically at risk of being lost.

clue.text: Old-timer wasted, we hear

parts.note: an old device for timing, with sand, whose shape is narrow in the middle; wasted said aloud matches the word for having a narrow waist

explanation.walkthrough: The grid prints HOURCLASS, a misread of the G.
explanation.definitionFit: A sand timer is an antique timekeeper, and its pinched shape is waisted, which sounds like wasted.

clue.text: Half-baked pudding is hard

parts.note: a fool is a dessert of fruit purée folded into cream
H is the pencil-grading abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: A complaint that an undercooked dessert has turned out tough.
explanation.walkthrough: A FOOL is a British dessert of stewed fruit and cream. 'Half-baked' reads as a cooking comment on the pudding, but it is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Half-baked describes an idea that is ill-considered or silly.

clue.text: Big-shot in the film world?

parts.note: reads as a movie celebrity, but means a camera shot in which the subject looks big because it is filmed near

explanation.definitionFit: A tight camera shot makes the subject fill the frame, so it is literally a big shot in cinema.

clue.text: Boards get initial support behind the scenes

indicators.note: the boards acquire something in first position, so the support word comes before them

parts.note: to back is to support
the boards is an old phrase for the theatre stage

explanation.surface: Theatre planks being given their first brace by builders.
explanation.definitionFit: Behind the scenes in a theatre is the area out of view of the audience.

clue.text: A singular display of musical virtuosity

definitions.text: A singular display of musical virtuosity

parts.words: A singular display of musical virtuosity
parts.note: singular means remarkable on the surface but literally one person, playing several instruments at once

explanation.definitionFit: A busker playing drum, harmonica and guitar together is a solo performer doing an orchestra's job.

clue.text: Freight unopened in Jason's ship

indicators.note: a word left unopened loses its first letter

parts.note: freight is cargo

explanation.surface: Goods stowed sealed aboard the vessel of the Argonauts.
explanation.walkthrough: The grid prints ARCS, a misread of ARGO. 'unopened' removes the C from CARGO.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth Jason sailed with the Argonauts in search of the Golden Fleece aboard this vessel.

clue.text: It does, with time

parts.note: suggests something happening eventually, but means the word is a sound-match partner for the word time

explanation.definitionFit: Words such as chime and dime sound alike at the end, which is the defining property of verse matching.

clue.text: Time to check the lines after casting?

definitions.text: Time to check the lines after casting?

parts.words: Time to check the lines after casting?
parts.note: sounds like an angler checking fishing lines after a cast, but means actors running through their script once roles are assigned

explanation.definitionFit: Once a play is cast, the actors practise their parts in a run-through before performance.

clue.text: The main link between Denmark and Sweden

definitions.text: The main link between Denmark and Sweden

parts.words: The main link between Denmark and Sweden
parts.note: main means the sea here, so this is the stretch of water joining the two countries, not the chief bridge

explanation.definitionFit: The strait lying between Jutland and the Swedish coast is the sea link between the two nations.

clue.text: Go on board deck

parts.note: a go, as in your go, is a turn
a board is a table, as in board and lodging

explanation.surface: Someone told to climb onto a ship's deck.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Go on board' reads as boarding a ship; 'on' just joins the pieces, and 'deck' is the record deck.
explanation.definitionFit: A record deck is the rotating platform on which vinyl discs are played.

clue.text: Group of men in pursuit of a mate

definitions.text: Group of men in pursuit of a mate

parts.words: Group of men in pursuit of a mate
parts.note: suggests bachelors hunting a partner, but the men are pieces on a board and the mate is checkmate

explanation.definitionFit: The playing pieces of the board game are called men, and the game's aim is checkmate.

clue.text: Betray willingness to accept a takeover bid

definitions.meaning: to betray is to abandon one's principles or allies for gain

definitions.text: willingness to accept a takeover bid
definitions.meaning: shareholders agreeing to sell their company to a bidder

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to betray a cause; as a noun it can mean agreeing to sell up to a buyer.

clue.text: Shows great enthusiasm for wild parties

definitions.meaning: to show great enthusiasm for something is to rhapsodise about it
large dance parties, often all-night ones

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to praise extravagantly; as a plural noun it means lively dance gatherings.

clue.text: House accommodating an orchid

indicators.note: a house accommodating something holds it inside

parts.note: a villa is a large house

explanation.surface: A dwelling with room for a single exotic flower.
explanation.definitionFit: The flavouring comes from the pods of a climbing tropical orchid of the same name.

clue.text: Dog-end

definitions.meaning: to dog someone is to follow them closely
an end is the rear part of something

explanation.definitionFit: To shadow someone covertly, and the rear part of an animal or thing; the clue reads as a cigarette butt.

clue.text: Corner at 90

parts.note: might suggest someone cornered at a great age, but means a corner of ninety degrees

explanation.definitionFit: A square corner measures ninety degrees.

clue.text: Lift shafts, we hear

indicators.note: we hear tells the solver the word for shafts is matched by its sound

parts.note: shafts of light are rays

explanation.surface: Lift shafts said to make a particular noise.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lift shafts' reads as the vertical passages for elevators.
explanation.definitionFit: To lift something is to elevate it.

clue.text: Look around a ship of the line

indicators.note: the look word goes around the other pieces

parts.note: lo is an old word for look
SS, steamship, is a common abbreviation for ship

explanation.surface: Inspecting a big warship of the fleet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a ship of the line' reads as a naval warship; the definition is 'line', a rope.
explanation.definitionFit: A cowboy's rope with a running noose is a kind of line.

clue.text: Result of converting sea into land

indicators.note: converting means changing the letters into a new form

explanation.definitionFit: The Baltic republic is a country, a land.

clue.text: Bloke is sort to get the needle

indicators.note: to sort is to put letters into a different order

explanation.surface: A man of a certain type who gets angry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'get the needle' reads as getting annoyed; 'sort' rearranges BLOKE IS.
explanation.definitionFit: Cleopatra's Needle in London is an ancient Egyptian stone pillar of this kind.

clue.text: Vehicle it is illegal to leave in the street

definitions.meaning: a curtained couch carried on poles, used to transport a person

definitions.text: it is illegal to leave in the street

explanation.walkthrough: The grid prints LETTER, a misread of LITTER.
explanation.definitionFit: A sedan-like carried couch was a means of transport, and rubbish dropped in public is an offence.

clue.text: Musical instruction, for example, accepted by alto in arrangement

indicators.note: accepted by means taken inside the shuffled letters
an arrangement in music reorders the parts, here the letters

explanation.surface: An instruction written into a score arranged for the alto voice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in arrangement' turns ALTO into LATO; 'accepted by' puts EG inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: The Italian term on a score tells players to perform smoothly and connectedly.
